messages:
Juno: Hi all, opening my very first PR to add a tiny helper in the codebase. Quick runbook: preferred branch prefix, who to tag for a fast runtime review, and a short local checklist to avoid flaky CI?

Ava: Congrats! Branch off `main`. For tiny helpers we use `chore/<short-desc>` (e.g. `chore/kv-helper`). For tracked tasks use `feature/TICKET-1234-desc`.

Riley: Reviewers: check CODEOWNERS, but for runtime helpers ping @Mira. If touching observability, add @Riley. Keep PRs single-concern.

Mira: Local checklist I expect: `make lint`, `pytest tests/ -k fast`, and add a unit test that exercises the helper. If there is a config flag, include a note in the PR about rollout.

Juno: Merge style? squash?

Ava: Squash with conventional commit format: `chore(runtime): add kv helper` or `fix(runtime): ...`. Put implementation details in the PR body.

Riley: Small PR body template to copy: Summary, Why, Change, Tests, Rollout. Keep < 6 bullets. Also add `release-note: none` if internal-only.

Juno: CI flake process?

ci-bot: If a CI job flakes, mention me and paste the failing job name. To rerun locally: `./scripts/ci_local_retry.sh <job>`. In GH Actions click "Re-run jobs" to kick a retry.

Mira: If your diff touches performance paths, label `runtime-impact` and include a quick local bench command. Otherwise the fast tests + lint are enough.

Juno: Awesomethanks all. I'll branch as `chore/kv-helper`, run lint+fast tests, add a unit test and ping @Mira + @Riley. :party_parrot:
